gallery.title: File:111031-F-HS721-186 (6305316130).jpg
gallery.description: Two Canadian service members wearing red poppy flowers attend a ramp ceremony at Bagram Airfeld, Oct. 31, to honor Master Corporal Byron Greff, 3rd Battalion Princess Patricia's Canadian Light Infantry. Greff was killed in an Oct. 29 Taliban attack when a vehicle packed with explosives rammed into the armored passenger Rhino Greff was traveling in. Greff served as a NATO Training Mission advisor and instructor, developing trainers to educate Afghan Army service members. Approximately 920 Canadian Forces personnel serve in advisory and support roles at training camps and headquarters locations primarily in the Kabul area. (U.S. Air Force photo by Senior Airman Kat Lynn Justen)

gallery.description: A C-5 Galaxy from Travis Air Force Base, Calif., sits on the ramp as the sun sets prior to a sortie at Bagram Air Field, Afghanistan, Dec. 28, 2015. The C-5 Galaxy is a heavy airlifter with intercontinental range. It is the largest U.S. military aircraft, capable of carrying more than 270,000 pounds of cargo.
